integrity: Analytical derivation with independent matrix computations and deterministic numerical checks; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Two-frame stationary Gaussian relative entropy only, not hidden-process path entropy or finite-sample statistical efficiency. Positive fixed coupling, unequal positive bath temperatures, and independent sensor errors with covariance proportional to bath diffusivity are required. A broader unpublished or unrecognized Gaussian-noise observation theorem could overlap; priority is not independently certified.
title: Universal high-precision sampling scale for observed Brownian-gyrator irreversibility
